items.title: Awesome Nix
items.content_text:
### Resources / Learning

*   [Nix in 100 Seconds](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FJVFXsNzYZQ) - A YouTube video from Fireship presenting Nix in 100 seconds.
*   [Tour of Nix](https://nixcloud.io/tour/) - An online interactive tutorial on Nix language constructs.

### Resources / Discovery

*   [Searchix](https://searchix.ovh/) - Search Nix packages and options from NixOS, Darwin and Home Manager.

### Deployment Tools / Discovery

*   [terraform-nixos (⭐376)](https://github.com/nix-community/terraform-nixos) - A set of Terraform modules designed to deploy NixOS.

### Virtualisation / Discovery

*   [microvm (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/microvm-nix/microvm.nix) - NixOS-based MicroVMs.

### Command-Line Tools / Discovery

*   [angrr (⭐40)](https://github.com/linyinfeng/angrr) - Auto Nix GC Roots Retention. This tool simply deletes auto GC roots based on the modified time of their symbolic link target.
*   [nh (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/nix-community/nh) - Better output for `nix`, `nixos-rebuild`, `home-manager` and nix-darwin CLI leveraging `dix` and `nix-output-monitor`.
*   [nix-index (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/nix-community/nix-index) - Quickly locate Nix packages with specific files.
*   [statix (⭐708)](https://github.com/oppiliappan/statix) - A linter/fixer to check for and fix antipatterns in Nix code.

### Development / Discovery

*   [Cachix](https://www.cachix.org) - Hosted binary cache service; free for open-source projects.
*   [Devbox (⭐10k)](https://github.com/jetify-com/devbox) - Instant, portable, and predictable development environments.
*   [pre-commit-hooks.nix (⭐694)](https://github.com/cachix/git-hooks.nix) - Run linters/formatters at commit time and on your CI.
*   [robotnix (⭐700)](https://github.com/nix-community/robotnix) - A declarative and reproducible build system for Android (AOSP) images.

### DevOps / Discovery

*   [Nix GitLab CI](https://gitlab.com/TECHNOFAB/nix-gitlab-ci) - Define GitLab CI pipelines in pure Nix with full access to all Nix packages (incl. caching).

### Programming Languages / Ruby

*   [ruby-nix (⭐140)](https://github.com/inscapist/ruby-nix) - Generates reproducible ruby/bundler app environment with Nix.

### Programming Languages / Rust

*   [naersk (⭐869)](https://github.com/nix-community/naersk) - Build Rust packages directly from `Cargo.lock`. No conversion step needed.
*   [nix-cargo-integration (⭐203)](https://github.com/90-008/nix-cargo-integration) - A library that allows easy and effortless integration for Cargo projects.
*   [rust-nix-templater (⭐49)](https://github.com/90-008/rust-nix-templater) - Generates Nix build and development files for Rust projects.

### NixOS Modules / Zig

*   [nix-darwin (⭐4.4k)](https://github.com/nix-darwin/nix-darwin) - Manage macOS configuration just like on NixOS.
*   [NixOS hardware (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/NixOS/nixos-hardware) - NixOS profiles to optimize settings for different hardware.

### NixOS Configuration Editors / Desktop apps

*   [NixOS Configuration Editor (⭐573)](https://github.com/snowfallorg/nixos-conf-editor) - Graphical editor for NixOS configuration. Desktop app in Rust and GTK.
*   [Nix Software Center (⭐712)](https://github.com/snowfallorg/nix-software-center) - Install and manage Nix packages. Desktop app in Rust and GTK.
